Earlier chapters built small networks and trained them in seconds.
This lecture looks at what the same parts become at scale,
and where they are used:

1.  how many [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) a [language model](language-models.qmd#def-language-model) built from [Transformer block](attention-transformers.qmd#def-transformer-block)s has,
    and how much computation training it takes;
2.  how a [pretrained](attention-transformers.qmd#def-pretraining) model can do a new task from examples in its input alone;
3.  how to adapt a large model by training a small number of new parameters;
4.  how speech becomes an input that image networks can read;
5.  how a Transformer can classify images.
